metrics.name: coverage_percent
metrics.remediation: Run make test-coverage and add meaningful behavioural tests for uncovered paths.

metrics.name: architecture_import_contract_failures
metrics.remediation: Run lint-imports --config .importlinter and remove or explicitly govern new dependency-direction violations.

metrics.name: complexity_xenon_blocks
metrics.remediation: Run radon/xenon and simplify or extract the named high-complexity functions.

metrics.name: dead_code_findings
metrics.remediation: Run vulture src/app tests --min-confidence 80 and remove proven dead code or document a reviewed exception.

metrics.name: dependency_findings
metrics.remediation: Run deptry . and fix missing, transitive-only, or unused dependency declarations.

metrics.name: security_undefined_findings
metrics.remediation: Run bandit -q -r src/app -c pyproject.toml and remove or explicitly review each new undefined-severity finding.

metrics.name: security_low_findings
metrics.remediation: Run bandit -q -r src/app -c pyproject.toml and remove or explicitly review each new low-severity finding.

metrics.name: security_medium_findings
metrics.remediation: Run bandit -q -r src/app -c pyproject.toml and remove or explicitly review each new medium-severity finding.

metrics.name: security_high_findings
metrics.remediation: Run bandit -q -r src/app -c pyproject.toml and fix every high-severity finding before merge.

metrics.name: documentation_percent
metrics.remediation: Run interrogate src/app and add useful public-facing documentation without writing filler docstrings.

metrics.name: openapi_spectral_problems
metrics.remediation: Run spectral lint openapi.json --ruleset .spectral.yaml and fix new API governance violations.
